title: 野生眉做完第一个月，需要观察什么
title_en: What to observe during the first month
intro: 做完野生眉的头一个月里，颜色明暗、线条边缘和皮肤触感都会经过自然稳定期。把项目规则和日常观察分开看，心里才不会慌。
intro_en: During the first month after hair-stroke brows, apparent darkness, crispness and skin texture gradually settle. Knowing which rules belong to your specific method keeps aftercare calm.

sections.title: 仪器野生眉 vs 手工野生眉：头一周安排完全不同
sections.title_en: Instrument vs manual brows: week-one care differs completely
sections.description: 画派仪器野生眉、画派双仪器初绒野生眉属于没有尴尬期的项目，操作当天即可正常碰水洗脸、护肤化妆；而手工野生眉有结痂期和尴尬期，做完前一周颜色可能会显得偏深，前1–2天尤其需要注意按交代护理，整体恢复期通常参考约7天。千万不要把不同做法的碰水或护理时间混着照搬。
sections.description_en: Huapai single- and dual-instrument brows avoid an awkward heavy-scabbing stage and allow normal face washing the same day. Manual brows involve a scabbing phase, often looking darker in week one with extra care in the first 1–2 days and an approximate 7-day healing guide. Never borrow another method’s timeline.

sections.title: 中间可能出现反色偏淡或轻微脱屑，切忌用手抠
sections.title_en: Temporary lightness or mild flaking: never pick the skin
sections.description: 无论哪种方式，表层角质更新和轻微表面代谢期间，你可能会觉得某几天线条变浅了、局部有细微皮屑或不像刚出工作室那么锋利。这是角质层包裹和正常代谢的过渡表现，绝对不能手痒去撕扯或揉搓，以免连带把表浅层的色素一起蹭掉。
sections.description_en: As surface skin renews, strokes can temporarily look softer or show light flaking. Never rub or pick at the area, as pulling off dry skin early can lift superficial pigment prematurely.

sections.title: 清洁、修复包与异常情况判断
sections.title_en: Cleansing, the aftercare kit and when to contact us
sections.description: 操作结束工作室都会赠送配套修复包，按照乐乐老师当天针对你所选项目的交代使用即可；平时洗脸避开强力搓洗、暂停在眉部刷酸或使用高浓度美白去角质产品。如果在恢复期感到明显红肿加重、持续疼痛或异常渗出，不要自行涂抹杂乱药膏，第一时间联系老师沟通，必要时前往正规医疗机构评估。
sections.description_en: Every client receives an aftercare kit with instructions tailored to their procedure; avoid harsh scrubbing, exfoliating acids or active brightening products directly over the brows. If marked redness, persistent discomfort or unusual changes occur, contact the studio promptly and seek medical evaluation when appropriate.

sections.title: 一个月后稳定复看与一年内补色衔接
sections.title_en: Reviewing settled colour and scheduling your touch-up
sections.description: 通常等皮肤完全稳定、表层返色清楚后再来看整体浓淡和线条连贯度，这时候判断需不需要微调最准确。如局部希望再稍加深一点，或某个眉尾断点想衔接得更满，利用一年内免费补色权益预约复看微调，比刚做完就急于加浓更稳妥。
sections.description_en: Once surface renewal settles, overall tone and line continuity become clear enough for an objective check. Use your one-year free touch-up to refine minor gaps or density safely after healing stabilises.
